summary: Assess property, rental and financing risks with practical ISO 31000-based exercises. Review the five-day course outline and plan your training.
lede: Real estate investment risk management provides a structured way to assess risks affecting property income, value and liquidity. Designed for property analysts, asset managers and investment professionals, the course develops skills in building risk registers, testing rental and financing assumptions, and reviewing acquisition evidence to prioritize risks and document investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess property acquisitions, monitor investment assets or prepare evidence for capital decisions. It suits foundation-level learners who work with property information and need a practical method for recording and prioritizing investment risks.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with property investment terms, rental income and acquisition decisions is helpful. Coding is not required; practical spreadsheet work uses Excel.
